definition_zh: 垫子；小地毯；门口地垫；体操垫；缠结的一团
definition_en: a flat piece of material laid on a surface for protection or comfort, a small rug at a door, a thick padded sheet used in sport, or a thick tangled mass
core_image: 一块粗糙的草席铺在地上，鞋底的泥都落在它上面
scene: 雨刚停，杂货铺门口的水泥地上摊着一块深色垫子，进门的人都在上面蹭两下鞋底。A faded mat lay by the shop door and caught the mud from every boot.
sceneCN: 这里 mat 是「门口地垫；小地毯」（第 2 个义项：铺在门口、供人蹭鞋的小块织物）；句意为门边摊着一块褪色的垫子，接住每双靴子带进来的泥。图中可辨识物件：湿水泥地、褪色垫子、进门的人。

pos.zh: 垫子；小地毯；体操垫；缠结的一团

derivatives.zh: 由 mat 加表示「材料、结果」的后缀 -ing 构成，义为「编垫的材料；垫子总称」
由 mat 加 -ed 构成，义为「缠结成团的；压成一片的」
由 door 与 mat 复合而成，义为「门垫」，也指任人欺负的人

senses.title: A flat pad laid on a surface
senses.definition: a flat piece of material placed on a table, floor or other surface to protect it or to set things on
senses.definitionCN: 铺在桌面、地面或其他表面，用来保护表面或放置物品的平整物件
senses.example: A woven mat kept the hot pot from marking the table.
senses.exampleCN: 一只编织垫隔在热锅与桌面之间，免得留下痕迹。
senses.why: Late Latin matta named a coarse woven cloth, so the object began as something spread flat and porous rather than as a solid slab.
senses.whyCN: 晚期拉丁语 matta 指粗糙的编织布，所以这件东西起初是一块摊平而透气的织物，而不是实心的板。

senses.title: A small rug at a door
senses.definition: a small piece of material placed at a door or beside a bed for people to wipe their feet or stand on
senses.definitionCN: 铺在门口或床边，供人蹭脚或站立的小块织物
senses.example: Mud from the lane was still wet on the door mat.
senses.exampleCN: 巷子里的泥在门口地垫上还湿着。
senses.why: Once a woven cloth lies where feet pass, it takes on the job of catching dirt, and the word moves from the cloth to the place it guards.
senses.whyCN: 当一块编织布铺在人脚经过的地方，它便担起了接住污垢的职责，词义也从布本身转到它所守护的那个位置。

senses.title: A thick padded mat for sport
senses.definition: a thick padded mat spread on a floor for gymnastics, wrestling or other training
senses.definitionCN: 铺在地上、供体操、摔跤或其他训练使用的厚实衬垫
senses.example: The coach spread a mat beneath the beam before the routine.
senses.exampleCN: 教练在平衡木下铺好垫子，才让队员开始动作。
senses.why: The same flat spread appears again in the gym, but here it must absorb a falling body, so thickness replaces the thin woven surface.
senses.whyCN: 同一块摊平的东西在体育馆里再次出现，只是这次要接住跌倒的身体，于是厚度取代了薄薄的编织面。

senses.title: A thick tangled mass
senses.definition: a thick mass of hair, grass or other material that has become tangled together
senses.definitionCN: 头发、草或其他材料缠结在一起形成的一团厚实物
senses.example: The rain had pressed the grass into a flat mat.
senses.exampleCN: 雨水把草压成了一片贴地的草毡。
senses.why: A mat is made of many strands pressed flat into one layer, so any tangle of strands squeezed into a layer can borrow the same picture.
senses.whyCN: 垫子本由许多细条压平、摊成一层，于是任何被挤成一层的细条团都能借用同一个画面。

intro.en: Mat is a plain word for a coarse woven spread; it reached English through Germanic forms from Late Latin matta, whose deeper origin is uncertain.
intro.cn: mat 是个朴素的词，指粗糙的编织铺物；它经日耳曼语形式从晚期拉丁语 matta 进入英语，更早的来源并不确定。

items.en: Matta named a coarse cloth or mat woven from rushes, the sort spread on a floor or used to wrap goods.
items.cn: matta 指用灯心草编成的粗布或席子，正是铺在地上或用来包东西的那一种。

items.en: The source of matta is uncertain; some accounts suggest a North African or Punic origin, but no Latin cognate settles the question.
items.cn: matta 的来源不确定；有些说法推测它出自北非或布匿语，但没有任何拉丁同族词能定论。

items.en: Old English matte named a mat or a bed of rushes, and it kept the plain sense of something spread flat.
items.cn: 古英语 matte 指席子或草铺，保留了「摊平铺开」这一朴素意思。

items.en: Middle English dropped the final vowel and wrote mat, while matting named both the material and the work of weaving it.
items.cn: 中古英语去掉词尾元音，写作 mat；matting 则兼指材料与编织这门活。

items.en: Modern English keeps the floor sense and extends it to gym padding, table mats and any thick tangled mass.
items.cn: 现代英语保留铺地之义，并把它扩展到体操垫、餐桌垫，以及任何缠结成一团的厚实物。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers derivatives and one close spelling; the near group gathers other flat things laid down for comfort or protection.
note.cn: 形近组收派生词与一个拼写相近的词；近义组收其他为舒适或保护而铺开的扁平物件。

entries.definition: Material woven into mats, or mats taken together.
entries.definitionCN: 编成垫子的材料，或垫子的总称；由 mat 加 -ing 构成。

entries.definition: Pressed or tangled into a thick mass.
entries.definitionCN: 被压成或缠成一团的；由 mat 加 -ed 构成。

entries.definition: A mat placed at a door, or a person who accepts being treated badly.
entries.definitionCN: 放在门口的垫子；也指任人欺负的人；由 door 与 mat 复合而成。

entries.definition: Having a dull, non-shiny surface; the spelling is close but the word comes from another source.
entries.definitionCN: 表面无光泽的；只是拼写相近，词源不同，与 mat 无关。

entries.definition: A small carpet for part of a floor.
entries.definitionCN: 铺在地面一部分的小地毯。

entries.definition: A thick piece of soft material used for protection or comfort.
entries.definitionCN: 起保护或衬垫作用的厚软物。

entries.definition: A bag of soft material that supports the body or a surface.
entries.definitionCN: 支撑身体或表面的软垫。

entries.definition: A woven covering for a whole floor.
entries.definitionCN: 铺满整片地面的编织覆盖物。

normalIntro.en: The word is a flat woven spread at heart, and its family keeps returning to layers laid down, pressed together and finally tangled.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词骨子里就是一块摊平的编织铺物，它的同族词反复回到铺下的一层、压在一起的一层，最后缠成一团。

normal.en: Late Latin matta was a coarse cloth of rushes, so a mat was never a solid object but a flat woven sheet.
normal.cn: 晚期拉丁语 matta 是灯心草编的粗布，所以垫子从来不是实心物件，而是一块摊平的编织片。

normal.en: Old English matte kept that sense and passed it on as the modern word mat.
normal.cn: 古英语 matte 保留了这层意思，后来传成现代词 mat。

normal.en: Matting adds -ing and names the material or the whole set of mats, not one mat.
normal.cn: matting 加 -ing，指材料或垫子的总称，而不是某一块垫子。

normal.en: Matted adds -ed and describes strands that have been pressed into one layer, like wet hair.
normal.cn: matted 加 -ed，形容细条被压成一层，就像湿透的头发。

normal.en: Doormat joins door and mat; the figurative sense comes from people wiping their feet on someone.
normal.cn: doormat 由 door 与 mat 拼成；比喻义来自人们把脚在某人身上蹭干净。

abstract.en: A mat is a boundary: it takes the dirt so the floor behind it stays clean.
abstract.cn: 垫子是一道边界：它接下污垢，让背后的地面保持干净。

abstract.en: The same flat layer can protect a table, a wrestler or a field of grass, because the shape is simple enough to travel.
abstract.cn: 同一层扁平之物既能护住桌面、摔跤手，也能盖住一片草，因为形状足够简单，可以被搬到各处。

abstract.en: What is spread flat can later be pressed flat, and the word follows the strands all the way into a tangle.
abstract.cn: 摊平的东西后来会被压平，这个词就跟着那些细条一路走进缠结之中。

examples.en: She rolled up her yoga mat and left the studio.
examples.cn: 她卷起瑜伽垫，离开了练习室。

examples.en: The rain had pressed the grass into a flat mat.
examples.cn: 雨水把草压成了一片贴地的草毡。

examples.en: Mud from the lane was still wet on the door mat.
examples.cn: 巷子里的泥在门口地垫上还湿着。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「马特」——马特进门之前先在垫子上蹭两下鞋；记住 mat 是垫子，也是门口那块蹭鞋的小毯。

root: 晚期拉丁语 matta（灯心草编的粗席）经日耳曼语形式进入古英语作 matte，再演变为 mat；matta 更早的来源一般认为可能出自北非或布匿语，但存疑。

sensesIntro.en: The core is a flat woven layer spread on a surface; the senses then divide into the protective pad, the small rug at a door, the thick gym padding and the tangled mass.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是铺在表面上的一层扁平编织物；义项由此分成护面的垫子、门口的小毯、体育馆里的厚垫，以及缠结成的一团。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a coarse woven square laid on the ground, taking the mud from every passing boot.
core.cn: 核心意象：一块粗糙的编织方席铺在地上，接下每双经过的靴子带来的泥。

branches.en: a hot pot set down on a woven square
branches.cn: 热锅落在编织方垫上

branches.en: wet boots stopping at a shop door
branches.cn: 湿靴子在店门口停住

branches.en: a body landing on thick padding under a beam
branches.cn: 身体落在平衡木下的厚垫上

branches.en: wet grass pressed flat after a night of rain
branches.cn: 一夜雨后贴地压平的湿草

branches.en: thin under a plate, thick under a falling body
branches.cn: 薄的在盘下，厚的在跌落的身体下

intro.en: The word is carried by a Late Latin noun for coarse cloth, its Old English descendant, the English noun and three English endings that name material, state and a compound.
intro.cn: 这个词由晚期拉丁语里表示粗布的名词、它的古英语后代、英语名词本身，以及三个分别表示材料、状态与复合的词尾共同支撑。

latinIntro.en: Late Latin matta is the recorded form behind the family; its deeper source is uncertain, so only that one Latin form is claimed.
latinIntro.cn: 晚期拉丁语 matta 是这个词族有记录的形式；它更早的来源不确定，因此只列出这一个拉丁形式。

definition_zh: 比赛；火柴；相配的人或物；相配；匹配；比得上
definition_en: a contest between two sides, a small stick that makes fire when struck, a person or thing that fits another, or to fit with and be equal to something
core_image: 细木划过盒面迸出火星，两队人也正好站到对面
scene: 体育馆的看台上坐满了人，双方球员在场地两端排开，裁判把哨子放到嘴边。The final match began under a grey sky, with the crowd already on its feet.
sceneCN: 这里 match 是「比赛」（第 1 个义项：两队或两人按规则分胜负的较量）；句意为决赛在灰蒙蒙的天空下开始，看台上的人已经站了起来。图中可辨识物件：满座的看台、两端排开的球员、裁判的哨子。

pos.zh: 比赛；火柴；相配的人或物

derivatives.zh: 由 match 与 box 复合而成，义为「火柴盒」
由表示「错误」的前缀 mis- 加 match 构成，义为「不匹配；错配」
由 match 与 maker 复合而成，义为「媒人；撮合者」
由表示「不」的前缀 un- 加 matched 构成，义为「无可匹敌的」

senses.title: A contest between two sides
senses.definition: a contest in which two people or teams compete under rules to win
senses.definitionCN: 两人或两队为争胜而按规则进行的较量
senses.example: The final match began under a grey sky.
senses.exampleCN: 决赛在灰蒙蒙的天空下开始了。
senses.why: The pairing sense is older than the contest: a match was first a pair set against each other, and only later the event they played.
senses.whyCN: 配对义比比赛义更早：match 起初是被摆到彼此对面的一对，后来才指这一对人所进行的赛事。

senses.title: A small stick that makes fire
senses.definition: a small piece of wood or paper with a treated head that makes fire when struck
senses.definitionCN: 带药头的小木梗或纸梗，摩擦时起火
senses.example: He struck a match and the lamp caught at once.
senses.exampleCN: 他划着一根火柴，灯立刻亮了。
senses.why: The fire sense comes from a different word altogether, one that named the wick of a lamp before it named a stick you strike.
senses.whyCN: 「火柴」这个义项来自另一个完全不同的词：它先指灯芯，后来才指手里用来划的那种小梗。

senses.title: A person or thing that fits another
senses.definition: a person or thing that is exactly suitable for another and forms a good pair with it
senses.definitionCN: 与另一个人或物恰好合适、能配成一对的人或物
senses.example: The two of them are a good match in temperament.
senses.exampleCN: 他们两人在性情上是很好的一对。
senses.why: Old English gemæcca meant a mate or an equal, so suitability was built into the word before it ever meant a game.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 gemæcca 本就指配偶或地位相当的人，所以「合适」这层意思在它指比赛之前就已经长在词里了。

senses.title: To fit together with something else
senses.definition: to be the same as, or to fit together with, something else
senses.definitionCN: 与另一事物相同，或彼此契合、对得上
senses.example: The curtains match the colour of the old walls.
senses.exampleCN: 窗帘的颜色和老墙很相配。
senses.why: If two things form a match, the verb names the act of bringing them into that pair, which is why colours, names and records can all be matched.
senses.whyCN: 若两样东西构成一对，动词便表示把它们配成那一对的动作，所以颜色、名字与记录都能 match。

senses.title: To be equal in strength or quality
senses.definition: to be equal in strength, speed or quality to someone or something
senses.definitionCN: 在力量、速度或水准上与某人某物相当，不落下风
senses.example: No one in the class could match her speed at the bench.
senses.exampleCN: 班上没有人在实验台前比得上她的速度。
senses.why: A match is also an equal opponent, so the verb means placing yourself beside that equal and finding nothing missing.
senses.whyCN: match 也指势均力敌的对手，所以动词表示把自己摆到那个对手旁边，发现并不缺什么。

intro.en: Match is two words that came to look alike: one Germanic word for a pair or an equal, and one Latin word for a lamp wick that became the fire stick.
intro.cn: match 是两个后来长得一模一样的词：一个日耳曼词表示「一对、地位相当」，一个拉丁词表示「灯芯」，后者变成了火柴。

items.en: Gemæcca meant a mate, a companion or an equal, and it named the second half of a pair rather than a game.
items.cn: gemæcca 指配偶、同伴或地位相当的人，命名的是成对中的另一半，而不是一场比赛。

items.en: Myxa meant the wick of a lamp; it passed through Greek into Latin before it named anything that could be struck.
items.cn: myxa 指灯芯；它经希腊语进入拉丁语，那时还不指任何能划着的东西。

items.en: Old French meiche named a wick, and English borrowed it for the cord that carried fire to gunpowder and then for the little stick.
items.cn: 古法语 meiche 指灯芯，英语借它来指把火引到火药的引线，后来又指那根小木梗。

items.en: Middle English used matchen for pairing and meiche for the wick, and the two forms slowly merged in sound and spelling.
items.cn: 中古英语用 matchen 表示配对，用 meiche 表示灯芯，两种形式在读音与拼写上慢慢合流。

items.en: Modern English keeps both lines, so one word now covers a game, a small fire, a fitting partner and the act of equalling another.
items.cn: 现代英语把两条线索都留着，于是一个词同时覆盖比赛、小火、相配的伴侣，以及与他人相等这一动作。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers compounds and derivatives built on match plus one close spelling; the near group gathers words for contests, fitting partners and equals.
note.cn: 形近组收由 match 构成的复合词与派生词，外加一个拼写相近的词；近义组收表示比赛、合适的伴侣与地位相当者的词。

entries.definition: A small box for holding matches.
entries.definitionCN: 装火柴的小盒子；由 match 与 box 复合而成。

entries.definition: A pairing that does not fit well.
entries.definitionCN: 配得不好的组合；由表示「错误」的前缀 mis- 加 match 构成。

entries.definition: A person who arranges marriages or brings people together.
entries.definitionCN: 安排婚事或撮合别人的人；由 match 与 maker 复合而成。

entries.definition: To walk with regular steps, or the third month; the spelling is close but the source is different.
entries.definitionCN: 齐步走；也指三月；只是拼写相近，词源不同，与 match 无关。

entries.definition: A competition in which people try to win.
entries.definitionCN: 人们争胜的比赛。

entries.definition: A single occasion of play under rules.
entries.definitionCN: 按规则进行的一场游戏或比赛。

entries.definition: A person or thing that corresponds to another.
entries.definitionCN: 与另一方相对应的人或物。

entries.definition: A person of the same ability or rank as another.
entries.definitionCN: 能力或地位与他人相当的人。

normalIntro.en: Two histories meet in one spelling: a Germanic word for a pair and a Latin word for a wick, and the family keeps returning to pairing, fire and equal standing.
normalIntro.cn: 两条历史在同一个拼写里相遇：一个日耳曼词表示一对，一个拉丁词表示灯芯；同族词反复回到配对、火与势均力敌。

normal.en: Old English gemæcca meant a mate or an equal, which is why match still names one half of a good pair.
normal.cn: 古英语 gemæcca 指配偶或地位相当的人，所以 match 至今指一对中的另一半。

normal.en: Latin myxa meant a lamp wick, and that wick sense came through Old French meiche into the English fire stick.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 myxa 指灯芯，这层意思经古法语 meiche 进入了英语的火柴义。

normal.en: Matchbox and matchmaker are compounds, and both keep the pairing or the fire in plain view.
normal.cn: matchbox 与 matchmaker 都是复合词，一个把火摆在明处，一个把配对摆在明处。

normal.en: Mismatch adds mis- for a bad pairing, while unmatched adds un- for having no equal.
normal.cn: mismatch 加 mis- 指配得不好，unmatched 加 un- 指没有对手。

normal.en: Match as a verb asks you to put two things side by side until they fit; nothing is compared in the abstract.
normal.cn: 作动词的 match 要求你把两样东西摆在一起，直到它们对得上；比较从不发生在空处。

abstract.en: Pairing and fire meet in one word because both happen in a single instant of contact.
abstract.cn: 配对与火在一个词里相遇，因为两者都发生在接触的一瞬。

abstract.en: A match is a test of fit: the right two things leave nothing to correct.
abstract.cn: match 是一场契合的检验：对的那两样东西，不留需要修改的地方。

abstract.en: From a lamp wick to a whistle, the word keeps finding two sides and making them face each other.
abstract.cn: 从灯芯到哨声，这个词一直在寻找两边，让它们面对面。

examples.en: The two teams will play a match on Saturday.
examples.cn: 两队将在星期六进行一场比赛。

examples.en: She struck a match to light the candle.
examples.cn: 她划着一根火柴点蜡烛。

examples.en: No one can match his speed on the track.
examples.cn: 跑道上没有人比得上他的速度。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「马吃」——马要吃草，先得有人擦着一根小木梗点火；记住 match 是火柴，也是比赛和相配。

root: 这个词有两条来源：表示「一对、配偶」的义项出自古英语 gemæcca（配偶、地位相当的人）；表示「火柴」的义项出自拉丁语 myxa（灯芯），经希腊语与古法语 meiche 进入英语，两条词形后来合流。

sensesIntro.en: The core is two things brought face to face; the senses divide into the contest of two sides, the strike of a wick, the fitting partner, the act of fitting, and the equal who cannot be beaten.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是两样东西被摆到彼此对面；义项由此分成两方的比赛、灯芯的一划、合适的伴侣、使彼此契合的动作，以及无人能敌的对手。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thin stick scrapes across a box and a spark jumps, while two teams stand face to face.
core.cn: 核心意象：细木划过盒面迸出火星，两队人也正好站到对面。

branches.en: a whistle at the centre of a packed stand
branches.cn: 满座看台中央的一声哨响

branches.en: a spark taken from a box in a dark room
branches.cn: 暗屋里从盒面擦出的一点火星

branches.en: two people pushed together and finding they fit
branches.cn: 两个人被推到一处，发现彼此合适

branches.en: curtains chosen to sit beside an old wall
branches.cn: 照着老墙颜色挑出的窗帘

branches.en: a runner pulling level with the one ahead
branches.cn: 跑者追平了前面那一个人

intro.en: An Old English noun for a pair, a Latin noun for a wick, their French and English descendants, and three English endings carry the two histories into one modern word.
intro.cn: 一个表示「一对」的古英语名词、一个表示「灯芯」的拉丁语名词、它们在法语与英语里的后代，再加三个英语词尾，把两条历史装进一个现代词。

latinIntro.en: Only the fire sense has a Latin line: myxa, the lamp wick, came through Greek and Old French. The pairing sense is Germanic and has no Latin cognate.
latinIntro.cn: 只有「火柴」这一义项有拉丁线索：myxa（灯芯）经希腊语与古法语传来；「配对」这一义项属日耳曼语，没有拉丁同族词。

definition_zh: 配偶；（动物）配对的对象；伙伴；朋友（英式口语）；交配；配对
definition_en: a partner in a pair, especially for breeding, or to pair with such a partner
core_image: 两只海鸟年复一年在同一块礁石上重逢，替对方理掉颈羽上的盐粒，再合筑一个巢
scene: 两只海鸟年复一年在同一块礁石上重逢，替对方理去颈羽上的盐粒，再合筑一个巢。 Two seabirds meet again on the same rock year after year, preen the salt from each other's neck feathers, and build one nest: each has found a mate for life.
sceneCN: 这里 mate 指「长期共同繁殖的配偶」（第 1 个义项：配偶、配对对象）；句意为两只海鸟年年重逢、互相理羽并合筑一巢，各自找到了终生的配偶。可辨识物件：礁石、相互理羽的两只鸟、同一个巢、海水；对应第 1 个义项。

pos.zh: 伙伴；朋友（英式口语，尤用于男性之间）

senses.title: A partner in a breeding pair
senses.definition: one of the two animals or people that form a reproductive pair
senses.definitionCN: 构成繁殖配对的两只动物或两个人之一
senses.example: The male guards the nest while his mate feeds.
senses.exampleCN: 雄性看守巢，配偶外出觅食。
senses.why: The word began as 'one who shares food at the same table', and that image of a shared life became the image of a shared nest.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初指「同桌共食的人」，那幅共享生活的图景后来变成共享巢的图景。

senses.title: A spouse or long-term partner
senses.definition: a husband, wife or long-term romantic partner
senses.definitionCN: 丈夫、妻子或长期恋人
senses.example: He introduced her as his mate, not his girlfriend.
senses.exampleCN: 他介绍她是自己的伴侣，而不是女友。
senses.why: From the 1540s the noun named one of a married pair, and that sense remains the plainest one in many varieties of English.
senses.whyCN: 自 16 世纪 40 年代起，这个名词指已婚一对中的一方，这一义项在许多英语变体中仍是最平实的。

senses.title: A comrade or friend
senses.definition: a friend, especially a male friend addressed informally
senses.definitionCN: 朋友，尤指被随意称呼的男性朋友
senses.example: He turned up with two old mates from the docks.
senses.exampleCN: 他带着两个码头上的老朋友来了。
senses.why: The oldest sense was 'associate, fellow', and it survives in British informal speech long after the breeding sense took over in biology.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的意思是「同伴、伙计」，在生物学中繁殖义占主导之后，它仍存活于英式口语中。

senses.title: To pair for breeding
senses.definition: of animals, to come together in order to reproduce
senses.definitionCN: 动物为繁殖而结合在一起
senses.example: The two species rarely mate in the wild.
senses.exampleCN: 这两个物种在野外很少交配。
senses.why: The verb, recorded about 1600 in this sense, simply turned the noun into an action: to become a pair.
senses.whyCN: 这个动词在该义项约自 1600 年有记录，只是把名词变成动作：成为一对。

senses.title: To match two things
senses.definition: to join two things that belong together, such as parts or colours
senses.definitionCN: 把两个相配之物接合起来，如零件或颜色
senses.example: The two halves must be mated before the glue sets.
senses.exampleCN: 两半必须在胶凝固之前对接。
senses.why: If a mate is a matching partner, then to mate is to make two things into such a pair, even when neither is alive.
senses.whyCN: 如果 mate 是相配的伙伴，那么 to mate 就是把两物做成这样一对，即便两者都不是活物。

senses.title: A ship's officer
senses.definition: an officer on a merchant ship ranking below the master
senses.definitionCN: 商船上低于船长的驾驶员
senses.example: The mate checked the cargo before departure.
senses.exampleCN: 大副在开船前检查了货物。
senses.why: Shipboard hierarchy borrowed the word for a companion officer, and the rank survives in merchant and fishing fleets.
senses.whyCN: 船上的等级制度借用了这个表示同伴官员的词，这一职衔至今仍存于商船与渔船队。

senses.title: An assistant tradesman
senses.definition: a skilled worker's assistant in a trade, as in plumber's mate
senses.definitionCN: 行业熟练工的助手，如管道工的副手
senses.example: The plumber's mate fetched the right joint.
senses.exampleCN: 管道工的助手取来了合适的接头。
senses.why: In a trade the partner is the one who works alongside, so the word names a role rather than a relationship.
senses.whyCN: 在手艺行当里，伙伴就是并肩干活的人，因此这个词命名一种角色，而非一段关系。

senses.title: Abstract: one of a matched pair
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：相配一对中的一方
senses.definition: one of two things that correspond to each other, such as a glove or a shoe
senses.definitionCN: 彼此对应的两物之一，如手套或鞋
senses.example: He held up the left glove and asked where its mate was.
senses.exampleCN: 他举起左手的手套，问另一只在哪里。
senses.why: At its widest the word needs no animal and no friend: anything that completes a pair can be its mate.
senses.whyCN: 在最宽泛的用法里，这个词既不需要动物，也不需要朋友：任何补成一对的东西都能是它的 mate。

intro.en: Mate is a Germanic borrowing, not a Latin word. Middle Low German mate, gemate meant 'one eating at the same table', and English took it in the mid-fourteenth century as 'companion'.
intro.cn: mate 是日耳曼语借词，并非拉丁词。中低地德语 mate、gemate 意为「同桌进食的人」，英语在 14 世纪中叶把它借作「同伴」。

items.en: The compound *ga-matjon meant '(one) having food (*matiz) together (*ga-)'. The same *matiz lies behind English meat.
items.cn: 复合词 *ga-matjon 意为「共同（*ga-）拥有食物（*matiz）的人」。同一个 *matiz 也是英语 meat 的来源。

items.en: Middle Low German mate, gemate 'messmate, companion' is the immediate source, cognate with Dutch maat and German Maat.
items.cn: 中低地德语 mate、gemate「同餐伙伴、同伴」是直接来源，与荷兰语 maat、德语 Maat 同源。

items.en: English mate is recorded from the mid-fourteenth century meaning 'associate, fellow', and as a form of address among sailors and workers.
items.cn: 英语 mate 自 14 世纪中叶有记录，义为「伙伴、伙计」，并在水手与工人间用作称呼。

items.en: The sense 'one of a married pair' is recorded from the 1540s; the verb 'to pair, couple' from about 1500, with the animal sense from about 1600.
items.cn: 「已婚一对中的一方」义自 16 世纪 40 年代有记录；动词「配对、结合」约自 1500 年，动物交配义约自 1600 年。

items.en: The mate of checkmate is a different word: it comes through Old French from Persian shah mat 'the king is helpless'.
items.cn: checkmate 中的 mate 是另一个词：经古法语来自波斯语 shah mat「王已无路可走」。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin): the reconstruction of *matiz and its wider Indo-European links is debated, and the exact first date of the nautical rank is not settled.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源）：*matiz 的重构及其更广的印欧语联系存有争论；航海职衔的确切首见年代也无定论。

note.en: Group one separates the verb forms, the informal adjective and the unrelated chess word; group two holds nouns for a partner under different descriptions.
note.cn: 第一组区分动词形式、口语形容词与无关的国际象棋词；第二组是以不同描述指伴侣的名词。

entries.definition: The gerund of the verb: the act or period of pairing.
entries.definitionCN: 该动词的动名词：配对的动作或时期。

entries.definition: British informal 'friendly', built on the companion sense; it has no biological meaning.
entries.definitionCN: 英式口语「友好的」，建立在同伴义上；无生物学含义。

entries.definition: A fellow member of a class; the second element still means companion, not breeding partner.
entries.definitionCN: 同班成员；第二个成分仍是「同伴」，而非繁殖配偶。

entries.definition: From Persian shah mat 'the king is helpless': a chess term with no connection to companion or spouse.
entries.definitionCN: 来自波斯语 shah mat「王已无路可走」：国际象棋术语，与同伴或配偶无关。

entries.definition: A person one shares an activity, business or life with; wider than mate and often less biological.
entries.definitionCN: 共同从事活动、事业或生活的人；比 mate 更宽，常少些生物学色彩。

entries.definition: A husband or wife in a legal marriage; mate can be used far more loosely.
entries.definitionCN: 合法婚姻中的丈夫或妻子；mate 的用法远为宽松。

entries.definition: Someone who accompanies another; from Latin panis 'bread', the very image behind mate.
entries.definitionCN: 陪伴他人的人；来自拉丁 panis「面包」，正是 mate 背后的图景。

entries.definition: A person or thing holding the same role elsewhere; it stresses correspondence, not companionship.
entries.definitionCN: 在别处担任同样角色的人或物；强调对应，而非陪伴。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: mate came from a word for a table companion, so a mate is literally one who shares the table.
normal.cn: mate 来自「同桌的人」，所以配偶字面上就是共享餐桌的人。

normal.en: The family runs mate, mating, mated, matey, classmate, roommate, soulmate.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 mate、mating、mated、matey、classmate、roommate、soulmate。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: mate for life, find a mate, choose a mate, mate with.
normal.cn: 固定搭配：终生配对、寻找配偶、选择配偶、与……交配。

normal.en: Checkmate looks like a relative but comes from Persian.
normal.cn: checkmate 看似同族，其实来自波斯语。

normal.en: The nautical rank survives in merchant ships: the chief mate is below the master.
normal.cn: 航海职衔仍存于商船：大副在船长之下。

abstract.en: Picture two birds sharing one rock as if it were one table.
abstract.cn: 想象两只鸟共用一个礁石，仿佛那是同一张餐桌。

abstract.en: Picture a left glove waiting in a drawer for its other half.
abstract.cn: 想象抽屉里一只左手手套等着另一半。

abstract.en: Picture two parts that were machined to meet and cannot mistake each other.
abstract.cn: 想象两个被加工成彼此相合、不会认错的零件。

examples.en: The pair stays together for several seasons, mating on the same ledge.
examples.cn: 这一对会相伴数季，在同一处岩架上交配。

examples.en: He came to the party with an old mate from school.
examples.cn: 他带着一位老同学来参加聚会。

examples.en: She could not find the mate to that earring.
examples.cn: 她找不到那只耳环的另一只。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「mate（同桌的人）」——先同桌吃饭，后同巢育雏 → 伙伴、配偶

root: 中低地德语 mate/gemate「同桌共食者」← 原始日耳曼 *ga-matjon（*ga- 共同 + *matiz 食物）；与拉丁语无关，与 checkmate（波斯语 shah mat）无关。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one word from a table companion to a breeding partner, a spouse, a friend, an act of pairing, a mechanical fit, a ship's officer, an assistant, and finally either half of any pair.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项追踪同一个词：从同桌的伙伴，到繁殖配偶、配偶、朋友、配对动作、机械配合、船上大副、行业助手，最后是任何一对中的任一方。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two lives sharing one place, one table or one nest.
core.cn: 核心意象：两条生命共用一处地方、一张桌子或一个巢。

branches.en: SHARED LIFE: the biological partner, then the married one.
branches.cn: 共享生活：先是生物学配偶，再是婚姻配偶。

branches.en: SHARED WORK: the comrade at large, and the assistant in a trade.
branches.cn: 共享工作：广义的伙伴，以及行当中的助手。

branches.en: BECOMING A PAIR: animals pair, and parts are made to fit.
branches.cn: 成为一对：动物配对，零件被做成相合。

branches.en: A ROLE ON SHIP: the companion officer of the master.
branches.cn: 船上的角色：船长的同伴官员。

branches.en: WIDEST SCOPE: anything that completes a pair.
branches.cn: 最宽的范围：任何补成一对的东西。

intro.en: Mate is a Germanic noun and verb with no Latin element; its compounds are all native formations, which makes the word a good test of etymological honesty.
intro.cn: mate 是日耳曼语名词与动词，不含拉丁成分；其复合词都是本族构成，因此这个词很适合检验词源诚实度。

latinIntro.en: No Latin entries: mate is Germanic, and the apparent Latin neighbours (as in checkmate) come from Persian. Latin supplied nothing here.
latinIntro.cn: 不列拉丁词条：mate 属日耳曼语，看似拉丁的近邻（如 checkmate）来自波斯语。拉丁语在此没有贡献。

items.example: The word began as a table companion.
items.exampleCN: 这个词最初指同桌的伙伴。

items.example: Both mates defend the nest.
items.exampleCN: 两只配偶共同护巢。

items.example: The mated birds returned to the same ledge.
items.exampleCN: 已配对的鸟回到同一处岩架。

items.example: Mating follows a fixed display.
items.exampleCN: 交配在固定展示之后发生。

items.example: His matey manner helped.
items.exampleCN: 他同伴般的态度很有帮助。

items.example: A classmate shared her notes.
items.exampleCN: 一位同学分享了笔记。

items.example: The roommate pays half the rent.
items.exampleCN: 室友付一半房租。

items.example: They call each other soulmates.
items.exampleCN: 他们互称灵魂伴侣。

items.example: A teammate covered his shift.
items.exampleCN: 一位队友替他值了班。

definition_zh: 材料；原料；布料；素材、资料；物质的；重要的、实质性的
definition_en: the stuff from which something is made, cloth, facts used for a work, or being important and physical
core_image: 一匹摊在裁床上的灰蓝布料，剪刀沿粉线往里走，布屑落在木台上
scene: 裁床上的灰蓝布料摊开，剪刀沿粉线往里走，布屑落了一地。The tailor spreads the material and cuts along the chalk line.
sceneCN: 这里 material 指可裁剪缝制的织物（第 2 个义项：做衣服用的布料）；句意：裁缝把布料铺开，沿着粉线裁剪。图中可辨识物件：裁床、灰蓝布料、剪刀、粉线；对应第 1 个义项。

pos.zh: 材料；原料；布料；素材、资料
物质的；重要的、实质性的

forms.label: 单数（物质义通常不可数）
复数（指多种材料或布料）

derivatives.zh: 唯物主义者；追逐物质的人

senses.title: Stuff used to build or make
senses.titleCN: 用来建造或制作的材料
senses.definition: the substance out of which something is made or built
senses.definitionCN: 用来制造或建造某物的物质
senses.example: Bricks and timber were the material of the old bridge.
senses.exampleCN: 砖与木料是这座老桥的材料。
senses.why: Late Latin materialis was simply the adjective of materia 'stuff', so the noun kept the plain sense of the stuff itself.
senses.whyCN: 晚期拉丁 materialis 就是 materia「材料」的形容词，名词义因此保留了「料本身」这层直白意思。

senses.title: Cloth for sewing
senses.definition: fabric used for making clothes or furnishings
senses.definitionCN: 用来做衣服或家居用品的布料
senses.example: The tailor spread the material and cut along the chalk line.
senses.exampleCN: 裁缝把布料铺开，沿粉线裁剪。
senses.why: cloth was the material a household handled most often, so the word narrowed to fabric in everyday speech.
senses.whyCN: 布料是家庭最常打交道的材料，于是这个词在日常口语中收窄为「织物」。

senses.title: Facts and sources for a work
senses.definition: information, notes or sources used for writing, research or a report
senses.definitionCN: 用于写作、研究或报道的信息、笔记与来源
senses.example: The reporter gathered material for the story over three weeks.
senses.exampleCN: 记者用三周时间为这篇报道收集素材。
senses.why: what clay is to a pot, notes are to an article, so the same word covers the raw stuff of a text.
senses.whyCN: 黏土之于陶罐，正如笔记之于文章，于是同一个词也指文本的原料。

senses.title: Supplies and equipment
senses.definition: the things needed for a particular activity, usually in the plural
senses.definitionCN: 某项活动所需的物品，通常用复数
senses.example: The laboratory ordered its materials for the autumn term.
senses.exampleCN: 实验室订购了秋季学期要用的用品。
senses.why: in the plural the word counts separate items rather than an uncountable stuff, a shift English makes freely with substances.
senses.whyCN: 复数把不可数的「料」转成一件件可数的东西，英语对物质名词常有这种转换。

senses.title: Physical rather than spiritual
senses.titleCN: 物质层面的，与精神相对
senses.definition: belonging to the physical world rather than to thought or spirit
senses.definitionCN: 属于物理世界，而非思想或精神世界
senses.example: The material world still obeys physical law.
senses.exampleCN: 物质世界依然服从物理规律。
senses.why: the adjective kept the old opposition of stuff to spirit, so it describes whatever can be touched.
senses.whyCN: 形容词保留了「材料对精神」的古老对举，因此描述一切摸得着的东西。

senses.title: Important to a decision
senses.definition: significant enough to affect a decision, a contract or a judgment
senses.definitionCN: 重要到足以影响决定、合同或判断的
senses.example: The delay was material to the terms of the contract.
senses.exampleCN: 这次延误对合同条款有实质影响。
senses.why: law and accounting borrowed the word because a fact with real stuff in it can change an outcome.
senses.whyCN: 法律与会计借用这个词，因为有实体内容的事实才足以改变结果。

senses.title: Concerned with wealth
senses.definition: interested in money and possessions rather than in higher aims
senses.definitionCN: 看重金钱与财物而非更高追求
senses.example: They chased material gain and ignored the damage.
senses.exampleCN: 他们追逐物质利益，无视造成的损害。
senses.why: if the material world is what can be touched, then gain in that world is money and goods.
senses.whyCN: 既然物质世界就是摸得着的那一面，那么那一面的收获自然就是钱与物。

senses.title: A person suited to a role
senses.definition: a person considered as suitable raw stuff for a particular post or task
senses.definitionCN: 被看作适合某项职位或任务的「生料」
senses.example: She is good material for the debate team.
senses.exampleCN: 她是辩论队的好苗子。
senses.why: a person is treated as raw stuff to be shaped by training, which keeps the oldest sense of material alive in a comic way.
senses.whyCN: 人被当成可被训练塑造的生料，这以略带戏谑的方式保留了 material 最古老的意思。

intro.en: Material is Late Latin materialis, the adjective of materia 'stuff', which passed through Old French into English. Its parent noun is the same source as matter.
intro.cn: material 是晚期拉丁 materialis，即 materia「材料」的形容词，经古法语进入英语；其母名词与 matter 同源。

items.en: Materia meant timber, stuff and subject matter; the adjective materialis was formed on it in later Latin.
items.cn: materia 指木料、材料与题材；形容词 materialis 是晚期拉丁语在它之上构成的。

items.en: Materialis meant 'of matter, physical' and was used in philosophy to contrast the physical with the spiritual.
items.cn: materialis 意为「物质的、物理的」，在哲学中用来与精神相对。

items.en: Old French material brought the adjective and noun into English in the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries.
items.cn: 古法语 material 在十三、十四世纪把这个形容词与名词带入英语。

items.en: By the sixteenth century material was the ordinary word for cloth in a household, a sense that still survives in tailoring.
items.cn: 到十六世纪，material 已是家庭里指布料的常用词，这一义至今留在裁缝行当。

items.en: Modern law and accounting use 'material' for facts that can shift a decision, an extension of the idea of having real substance.
items.cn: 现代法律与会计用 material 指能改变决定的事实，这是「有实质」这一想法的延伸。

items.en: First recorded dates for the cloth, legal and accounting senses are approximate; the core adjective is well attested from the fourteenth century.
items.cn: 布料义、法律义与会计义的最早记录年代为约数；核心形容词义在十四世纪已有充分书证。

note.en: The first group holds near-forms of material, some sharing its Latin stock and some not; the second group holds words that overlap in meaning.
note.cn: 第一组是与 material 形近的词，有的同出拉丁词源，有的不是；第二组是词义部分重叠的词。

entries.definition: The noun and verb built directly on materia; material is its learned adjective, so the two share a root but not a part of speech.
entries.definitionCN: 直接由 materia 构成的名词与动词；material 是它的书面形容词，二者同根而词性不同。

entries.definition: The same word borrowed a second time from French and narrowed to military stores; it is not a separate root.
entries.definitionCN: 同一个词第二次从法语借入，收窄为军用物资；并非另一个词根。

entries.definition: From mater 'mother', not materia; any family resemblance rests on the unproven mater-materia hypothesis.
entries.definitionCN: 出自 mater「母亲」而非 materia；所谓亲缘只建立在那条未获证实的假说上。

entries.definition: The adverb of material, used for 'to a significant degree'; it is a derived form, not a separate word.
entries.definitionCN: material 的副词，表示「达到显著程度」；它是派生形式，不是另一个词。

entries.definition: Material seen as the thing that underlies qualities; substance is more abstract and less countable.
entries.definitionCN: 被看作承载属性的材料；substance 更抽象、更不可数。

entries.definition: Cloth made by weaving; it covers only the textile sense of material.
entries.definitionCN: 织成的布；只覆盖 material 的织物义。

entries.definition: One of the substances combined in a mixture; material is the broader word for what anything is made of.
entries.definitionCN: 混合物中的一种成分；material 是更宽泛的「造物之料」。

entries.definition: Facts that support a conclusion; it overlaps the legal sense of material but not the sense of source material.
entries.definitionCN: 支持结论的事实；与 material 的法律义部分重叠，但不指写作素材。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real Latin source, the real word family and real fixed phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实的拉丁来源、真实的同族词与真实的固定搭配。

normal.en: Materialis is the Latin adjective of materia, so material is literally 'of stuff'.
normal.cn: materialis 是 materia 的拉丁形容词，因此 material 字面上就是「属于材料的」。

normal.en: The family runs material, materially, materiality, materialism and materialize.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 material、materially、materiality、materialism 与 materialize。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the physical sense: raw material, building material, material world.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出物质义：原材料、建筑材料、物质世界。

normal.en: In law, a material fact is one that can change the outcome.
normal.cn: 在法律里，具有实质性的关键事实才能改变结果。

normal.en: The same Latin stock gives matter, and material is its adjective.
normal.cn: 同一拉丁词源也给出 matter，而 material 是它的形容词。

abstract.en: Picture a cutting table where the cloth decides what the coat can become.
abstract.cn: 想象一张裁床，布料本身决定了这件外套能做成什么样。

abstract.en: Picture a potter's hands choosing clay before any shape is attempted.
abstract.cn: 想象陶匠在动手塑形之前先挑泥料。

abstract.en: Picture a folder of notes that a writer keeps beside the blank page.
abstract.cn: 想象作家把一叠笔记放在空白稿纸旁边。

examples.en: Recycled material now accounts for a third of the plant's input.
examples.cn: 回收材料现在占这家工厂投入的三分之一。

examples.en: The committee judged the omission material to the audit.
examples.cn: 委员会认定这处遗漏对审计有实质影响。

examples.en: Course material is posted online before each lecture.
examples.cn: 课程材料在每次讲课前发布到网上。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「买铁料」——盖房装修先买铁、买料，买的都是材料 → 材料、原料

root: 拉丁 materia「材料、木料」→ 晚期拉丁 materialis（materia 加形容词后缀）「物质的」→ 古法语 material → 英语 material；「布料」「重要」义由「做成东西的料」再引申。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all treat something as the stuff a thing is made from: bricks for a bridge, cloth for a coat, notes for a story, supplies for a term, the physical world for the spirit, facts for a decision, money for a life, and a person for a post.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都把某物当作「造物之料」：桥的砖、外套的布、报道的笔记、学期的用品、对抗精神的物质世界、影响决定的实据、支撑生活的钱财，以及适合某职位的人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: cloth on a cutting table, waiting to become something else.
core.cn: 核心意象：裁床上的一匹布，等着被做成别的什么。

branches.en: THE STOCK ITSELF: raw stuff in bulk, and the same stuff counted out as supplies for a term.
branches.cn: 原料本身：成批的生料，以及按学期点清的同一种用品。

branches.en: THE CLOTH ON THE TABLE: the material a household handles most often is fabric.
branches.cn: 桌上的那匹布：家庭最常打交道的材料就是织物。

branches.en: THE MATERIAL OF A TEXT: notes and sources are clay for a writer's pot.
branches.cn: 文本的料：笔记与来源是作家制陶的黏土。

branches.en: THE TOUCHABLE WORLD AND ITS GAINS: what can be touched, and what can be accumulated from it.
branches.cn: 可触摸的世界及其收获：摸得着的那一面，以及从那一面攒下的东西。

branches.en: STUFF THAT DECIDES: a fact with substance changes a contract, and a person with substance fills a post.
branches.cn: 起决定作用的料：有实质的事实能改动合同，有实质的人能补上职位。

intro.en: Material is one Latin root plus one adjective suffix, and both parts recur across a large English family.
intro.cn: material 由一个拉丁词根加一个形容词后缀构成，这两部分在英语的一大批词里反复出现。

latinIntro.en: Latin materia gives matter and material; the suffix -alis, through French -al, also shapes manual, editorial and commercial.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 materia 衍生 matter 与 material；后缀 -alis 经法语 -al 也构成 manual、editorial 与 commercial。

items.example: The root supplies the picture of raw stuff.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根提供「生料」的画面。

items.example: The suffix makes an adjective of stuff.
items.exampleCN: 后缀把「材料」变成形容词。

items.example: Material carries both the physical and the serious sense.
items.exampleCN: material 兼有物质与重要两义。

items.example: The same ending appears in manual and editorial.
items.exampleCN: 同一词尾出现在 manual 与 editorial 中。

items.meaning: the quality of being material or significant
items.example: Auditors test materiality before they test figures.
items.exampleCN: 审计师先判断重要性，再核对数字。

items.meaning: the belief that matter is all there is
items.meaningCN: 认为物质即一切的学说
items.example: The suffix turns a quality into a doctrine.
items.exampleCN: 后缀把一种性质变成一种主义。

items.example: The design materialized as a real bridge.
items.exampleCN: 设计落实成了一座真实的桥。

items.example: The prefix denies both the stuff and the weight.
items.exampleCN: 否定前缀同时否掉「实体」与「分量」。

items.example: A second borrowing narrowed to army stores.
items.exampleCN: 第二次借入的形收窄为军队物资。

definition_zh: 数学的；数学方法的；精确严密的
definition_en: relating to mathematics or to its methods; also used of reasoning that is as exact as mathematics
core_image: 一张草稿纸上，几行推导被框起来，旁边用箭头标出「若此，则彼」的关系
scene: 桌上摊着一张草稿纸，几行推导被方框圈住，旁边用箭头标出从前提到结论的去向。The proof rests on a purely mathematical argument, with no measurement involved.
sceneCN: 这里 mathematical 指「属于数学本身的」（第 1 个义项：与数学学科相关）；句意为这个证明依靠纯数学论证，不涉及任何测量。图中可辨识物件：草稿纸、方框、箭头、铅笔；对应第 1 个义项。

pos.zh: 数学的；数学方法的；精确严密的

senses.title: Belonging to mathematics
senses.definition: relating to the discipline of mathematics as such
senses.definitionCN: 与数学这门学科本身有关
senses.example: The proof rests on a purely mathematical argument, with no measurement involved.
senses.exampleCN: 这个证明依靠纯数学论证，不涉及任何测量。
senses.why: The plainest reading simply attaches the discipline's name to the thing described.
senses.whyCN: 最朴素的用法只是把学科之名挂到所描述的对象上。

senses.title: Using the tools of mathematics
senses.titleCN: 使用数学工具与方法的
senses.definition: carried out by means of equations, symbols or formal derivation
senses.definitionCN: 借助方程、符号或形式推导来完成的
senses.example: The paper gives a mathematical treatment of the spread of the disease.
senses.exampleCN: 这篇论文用数学方法处理疾病的传播。
senses.why: When a problem is handled with symbols rather than observations, the adjective marks the instrument used.
senses.whyCN: 当一个问题靠符号而非观察来处理时，这个形容词标出的就是所用工具。

senses.title: Exact and rigorously reasoned
senses.titleCN: 精确而推理严密的（引申）
senses.definition: so exact and tightly reasoned that no step is left loose
senses.definitionCN: 精确且推理严密，以致没有任何一步是松的
senses.example: Her account of the meeting was mathematical in its precision.
senses.exampleCN: 她对那次会议的叙述精确得像数学。
senses.why: Mathematics is the model of step-by-step certainty, so the adjective lends that quality to anything else.
senses.whyCN: 数学是一步接一步确定性的典范，这个形容词便把这种品质借给别的对象。

senses.title: Good with numbers
senses.definition: having a natural or trained ability with numbers and reasoning
senses.definitionCN: 在数字与推理上有天赋或受过训练的
senses.example: He is the most mathematical of the three children.
senses.exampleCN: 三个孩子里他最有数学头脑。
senses.why: A person can carry the adjective because ability in the field is a property of people.
senses.whyCN: 人可以带这个形容词，因为该领域的能力是人的属性。

senses.title: Abstract and symbol-driven
senses.definition: described as abstract, symbolic and detached from concrete objects
senses.definitionCN: 被描述为抽象的、符号化的、与具体事物脱开的
senses.example: The objection was too mathematical to satisfy the historians.
senses.exampleCN: 这个反对意见过于数学化，历史学家无法接受。
senses.why: To call something mathematical can also criticise it as remote from lived detail.
senses.whyCN: 说某物「太数学」也可以是在批评它远离实际细节。

senses.title: Treatable by a model
senses.definition: capable of being described and predicted by equations
senses.definitionCN: 能够用方程来描述和预测的
senses.example: Once the system became mathematical, its future could be simulated.
senses.exampleCN: 这个系统一旦被数学化，它的未来就可以模拟。
senses.why: A messy process becomes mathematical when it is reduced to quantities a model can carry.
senses.whyCN: 混乱的过程一旦被化简为模型能承载的量，就变得「可数学处理」。

senses.title: Of a formal proof
senses.definition: established by deductive proof from stated assumptions rather than by experiment
senses.definitionCN: 由所述前提演绎证明、而非由实验确立的
senses.example: No experiment can settle a question that is mathematical in form.
senses.exampleCN: 形式上属于数学的问题，任何实验都无法解决。
senses.why: Proof is the field's own way of settling things, so the adjective names that kind of certainty.
senses.whyCN: 证明是这门学问自己的定案方式，这个形容词便命名那种确定性。

senses.title: As certain as arithmetic
senses.titleCN: 像算术一样确定无疑的
senses.definition: used hyperbolically of a conclusion that seems impossible to dispute
senses.definitionCN: 夸张地用于形容似乎无可争辩的结论
senses.example: The failure was mathematical: given those prices, the firm could not survive.
senses.exampleCN: 这次失败是算定的：在那些价格下，公司无法存活。
senses.why: The hyperbolic use treats an outcome as something already written into the numbers.
senses.whyCN: 夸张用法把某个结果当作早已写进数字里的东西。

intro.en: The adjective is the Greek adjective for 'learned' or 'mathematical', plus the Latin adjectival ending. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: 这个形容词由希腊语表示「有学问的、数学的」形容词加拉丁形容词词尾构成。年代均为约数。

items.en: Mathēma 'something learned, a lesson' came from manthanein 'to learn'; the root behind the verb is reconstructed rather than attested.
items.cn: mathēma「所学之物、课业」源自动词 manthanein「学习」；动词背后的词根属重构形式，并无实证。

items.en: Mathēmatikos 'fond of learning, learned' was formed with the suffix -ikos 'belonging to'; it described people and things alike.
items.cn: mathēmatikos「爱学习、有学问的」由表示「属于」的后缀构成；人与物都可用它描述。

items.en: The neuter plural named the mathematical studies, and this is the form Latin took over.
items.cn: 中性复数指数学诸科，拉丁语承接的正是这个形式。

items.en: Latin mathematicus served as both adjective and noun, and could also mean 'astrologer' in later use.
items.cn: 拉丁 mathematicus 兼作形容词与名词，在后世也可指「占星者」。

items.en: English added the adjectival ending to the Latin stem in the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries, alongside the noun mathematics.
items.cn: 英语在十六、十七世纪给拉丁词干加上形容词词尾，与名词 mathematics 并行。

items.en: The sense 'exact, rigorously reasoned' grew from the prestige of proof, and is now the most common figurative use. First date uncertain: no single year is recorded for this extension.
items.cn: 「精确、推理严密」义由证明的声望生长出来，如今是最常见的比喻用法。首见年代不确定：这一引申没有确切年份记录。

note.en: Group one separates the adjective from its own family; group two separates words that also claim precision.
note.cn: 第一组辨析这个形容词与其同族形式；第二组辨析同样声称精确的词。

entries.definition: The older adjective and singular noun, now largely replaced by mathematical and mathematics.
entries.definitionCN: 更早的形容词与单数名词，今基本被「数学的」与「数学」两个形式取代。

entries.definition: The discipline itself; the adjective differs from it only by its ending, which is easy to miss in a scan.
entries.definitionCN: 指学科本身；形容词与它只差词尾，快速扫读时容易看漏。

entries.definition: A practitioner of the field; the ending marks a person where the adjective marks a quality.
entries.definitionCN: 指该领域的从业者；词尾标出人，而形容词标出性质。

entries.definition: The adverb modifies a verb, as in 'mathematically trained'; it cannot stand before a noun.
entries.definitionCN: 副词修饰动词，如「受过数学训练」；它不能置于名词前。

entries.definition: Concerned with numbers as such, often in the sense of values rather than proofs.
entries.definitionCN: 涉及数字本身，常指数值而非证明。

entries.definition: Concerned with measuring amounts; a quantitative study may use little formal mathematics.
entries.definitionCN: 涉及测量数量；定量研究可能只用很少的形式数学。

entries.definition: Strict and thorough in method; it praises careful procedure without invoking mathematics.
entries.definitionCN: 方法上严格彻底；它称赞程序的严谨，却不必涉及数学。

entries.definition: Precise in measurement or statement; mathematical reasoning is exact, but an exact figure need not be proved.
entries.definitionCN: 在测量或表述上精确；数学推理是精确的，但一个精确数字未必经过证明。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real fixed phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实固定搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The adjective is the discipline's name turned into a modifier, so it always describes something that belongs to the field.
normal.cn: 这个形容词是学科名转成的修饰语，因此总描述属于该领域之物。

normal.en: The Greek root meant 'learned', so the earliest sense praised learning rather than calculation.
normal.cn: 希腊词根意为「有学问的」，因此最早的义项称赞的是学问，而非计算。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the technical uses: mathematical model, mathematical proof, mathematical notation.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出技术用法：数学模型、数学证明、数学符号。

normal.en: The family runs mathematical, mathematics, mathematician, mathematically, and the verb mathematize.
normal.cn: 同族词包括数学的、数学、数学家、在数学上，以及动词「使数学化」。

normal.en: The word can also criticise: to call an argument too mathematical is to say it ignores people.
normal.cn: 这个词也可用于批评：说一个论证太数学化，就是说它忽视了人。

abstract.en: Picture a ruler laid across a page so that every line must follow its edge.
abstract.cn: 想象一把尺横在纸上，每一行都必须顺着它的边。

abstract.en: Picture a lock whose key is a proof: it opens only if every tumbler falls in order.
abstract.cn: 想象一把锁，钥匙是一份证明：只有每个弹子依次落位，它才打开。

abstract.en: Picture a bridge whose every stone was placed by calculation before anything was lifted.
abstract.cn: 想象一座桥，每块石料在起吊之前就已由计算放好。

examples.en: The model is mathematical, so it can be tested on a computer.
examples.cn: 这个模型是数学性的，因此可以在计算机上检验。

examples.en: She has a mathematical mind and never loses track of a proof.
examples.cn: 她有数学头脑，推导从不迷失。

examples.en: The argument was mathematical in its precision, if not in its warmth.
examples.cn: 这个论证在精确上像数学，尽管并不温情。

dict_mnemonic.text: 记作「学问的」转成「数理的」：词根意为学习，学得最严的那一门 → 数学的、严密的

root: 希腊 mathēmatikos「爱学习的、有学问的」= mathēma「所学之物」+ 表示「属于」的后缀；拉丁 mathematicus 兼作形容词与名词，英语十六、十七世纪加形容词词尾；「精确严密」义由证明的声望引申。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses fan out from one modifier: belonging to the discipline, using its tools, exact in reasoning, good with numbers, abstractly symbolic, modellable, formally proved, and finally as certain as arithmetic.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从一个修饰语扇开：属于该学科、使用其工具、推理精确、数字能力强、抽象符号化、可建模、形式可证，最后是像算术一样确定。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a page of derivation with boxes around each step and arrows from premise to conclusion.
core.cn: 核心意象：一页推导，每一步都加了方框，箭头从前提到结论。

branches.en: The field and its proof: what belongs to mathematics is settled by deduction, not by trial.
branches.cn: 学科与其证明：属于数学之事由演绎定案，而非靠试。

branches.en: The tool lent out: other subjects borrow equations to make themselves predictable.
branches.cn: 借出的工具：别的学科借方程来使自己可预测。

branches.en: Precision as a promise: no loose step, and a conclusion as certain as a sum.
branches.cn: 精确作为一种承诺：没有松掉的一步，结论像加法一样确定。

branches.en: The person: a mind that keeps its footing on a proof.
branches.cn: 人：在证明上不会失足的心智。

branches.en: The abstraction: the same quality turns into a criticism when it leaves people out.
branches.cn: 抽象：同一种品质一旦把人排除在外，就变成批评。

intro.en: The adjective is assembled from a Greek noun, a Greek suffix and a Latin adjectival ending, all of which also build its relatives.
intro.cn: 这个形容词由希腊名词、希腊后缀与拉丁形容词词尾组成，这些部件也构成它的亲属词。

latinIntro.en: Greek mathēma supplies the meaning, -ikos marks belonging, and Latin -alis (English -al) turns it into an English adjective.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语名词提供意义，希腊后缀标记「属于」，拉丁形容词词尾把它转为英语形容词。

items.example: The root supplies the learned element of the word.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根提供「学问」成分。

items.example: The suffix made an adjective out of the noun.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把名词变成形容词。

items.example: The Greek adjective is the direct ancestor of the English one.
items.exampleCN: 这个希腊形容词是英语形容词的直系祖先。

items.example: The Latin ending lets the Greek stem behave as an English adjective.
items.exampleCN: 拉丁词尾让希腊词干充当英语形容词。

items.example: The word describes whatever belongs to the field.
items.exampleCN: 这个词描述属于该领域之物。

items.example: The adverb marks how something is done.
items.exampleCN: 副词标记做某事的方式。

items.example: The noun names the field the adjective refers to.
items.exampleCN: 名词命名形容词所指的领域。

items.meaning: one who works in the field
items.example: The person suffix closes the family.
items.exampleCN: 表人后缀收拢了这个词族。

items.example: The verb names the act of turning something into mathematics.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词指把某物变成数学处理对象的行为。

latinEntries.structure: mathēma, mathēmatos (n., third declension, Greek loan)

definition_zh: 数学；数学学科；（某事物的）数学计算部分
definition_en: the branch of study that deals with numbers, quantities, shapes and the relations between them, using logical reasoning
core_image: 一整面黑板上密密的算式，粉笔灰落在槽沿，最后一行的等号被重重描了一遍
scene: 教室里一整面黑板写满算式，一名学生在角落补上一个等号，粉笔灰落在槽沿。She studied mathematics for four years before turning to economics.
sceneCN: 这里 mathematics 指「作为一门学科的数学」（第 1 个义项：研究数与形及其关系的学问）；句意为她学了四年数学之后才转向经济学。图中可辨识物件：黑板、粉笔、算式、板槽；对应第 1 个义项。

pos.zh: 数学（学科名，形式为复数而作单数用）

senses.title: The discipline as a whole
senses.definition: the field of study that reasons about number, quantity, structure and shape
senses.definitionCN: 研究数、量、结构与形的学问领域
senses.example: She studied mathematics for four years before turning to economics.
senses.exampleCN: 她学了四年数学之后才转向经济学。
senses.why: The word names a whole discipline rather than one of its branches, so it is used with a singular verb despite its plural shape.
senses.whyCN: 这个词命名的是整门学问而非某一分支，因此尽管外形是复数，却接单数动词。

senses.title: The school subject and its lessons
senses.definition: the subject taught in schools, together with the lessons and examinations that go with it
senses.definitionCN: 学校里教授的这一科目，以及随之而来的课程与考试
senses.example: Mathematics is timetabled before lunch three days a week.
senses.exampleCN: 数学课每周有三天排在午饭前。
senses.why: Once a discipline enters a timetable it becomes a subject, and the same word covers both the field and the hour it occupies.
senses.whyCN: 一门学问一旦进入课表就成了科目，同一个词既指这个领域，也指它占用的那一节课。

senses.title: Reckoning and reasoning in practice
senses.titleCN: 实际推算与推理的活动
senses.definition: the activity of calculating and reasoning with numbers in a particular situation
senses.definitionCN: 在具体情境中运用数字进行计算与推理的活动
senses.example: The mathematics behind the bridge design was checked twice.
senses.exampleCN: 这座桥设计背后的数学计算被核对了两遍。
senses.why: Here the word means the working itself, not the science of it: the sums someone actually did.
senses.whyCN: 这里这个词指实际运算本身，而不是关于运算的学问：某人真做过的那些计算。

senses.title: The mathematical side of a subject
senses.titleCN: 某一对象内部的数学机制
senses.definition: the quantitative structure and relationships that underlie a particular process or system
senses.definitionCN: 支撑某一过程或系统的数量结构与关系
senses.example: The mathematics of traffic flow decides where queues form.
senses.exampleCN: 车流的数学机制决定了排队会在哪里形成。
senses.why: Any system with regular quantities has a mathematics of its own, and the phrase names that structure rather than the discipline.
senses.whyCN: 任何具有规律数量的系统都有自己的数学，这个说法指那套结构，而非那门学科。

senses.title: The professional community
senses.definition: the community of people who work in the field, taken as a body
senses.definitionCN: 以整体看待的、从事这一领域的人所组成的群体
senses.example: The result was celebrated across mathematics before it was published.
senses.exampleCN: 这一结果在发表之前就已在数学界传开。
senses.why: A discipline also names its practitioners as a group, which is why one can speak of a whole field being excited.
senses.whyCN: 一门学问也指其从业者的群体，因此可以说整个领域为之振奋。

senses.title: Careful reckoning in plain speech
senses.definition: used informally for the calculating needed to make a decision come out right
senses.definitionCN: 口语中指为使某项决定算得过来所需的精密推算
senses.example: The mathematics of the deal did not survive the new tax.
senses.exampleCN: 这笔交易的账在新税之下算不过来了。
senses.why: Everyday speech borrows the discipline's name for the arithmetic of a practical decision.
senses.whyCN: 日常说法借这门学问之名，指一项实际决定背后的加减账。

senses.title: The old sense of learning
senses.definition: in its Greek origin, any branch of learning rather than the numerical sciences alone
senses.definitionCN: 在其希腊来源中泛指任何一门学问，而非仅指数理科学
senses.example: In the ancient curriculum, music and astronomy counted as mathematics.
senses.exampleCN: 在古代课程里，音乐与天文也算作数学。
senses.why: The Greek word meant something learned, so the discipline once covered far more ground than it does now.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语原词意为「被学到的东西」，因此这门学问早先涵盖的范围远大于今天。

senses.title: The mathematical content of a paper
senses.titleCN: 论文或模型中的数学内容
senses.definition: the equations, proofs and derivations contained in a piece of work
senses.definitionCN: 一项工作中所含的方程、证明与推导
senses.example: The biology paper was strong, but its mathematics was thin.
senses.exampleCN: 那篇生物学论文很强，但其中的数学部分薄弱。
senses.why: Readers separate a work's subject matter from its mathematical machinery, and this sense names the latter.
senses.whyCN: 读者会把一项工作的主题与其数学工具分开，这个义项指后者。

intro.en: The word goes back to Greek mathēma 'that which is learned', from manthanein 'to learn'. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: 这个词可追溯到希腊语 mathēma「被学到的东西」，源自动词 manthanein「学习」。年代均为约数。

items.en: Manthanein meant 'to learn', and gave mathēma 'a lesson, something learned' and mathesis 'learning'. The deeper root is reconstructed, not attested.
items.cn: manthanein 意为「学习」，由此得到 mathēma「课业、所学之物」与 mathesis「学习」。更深词根属重构形式，并无实证。

items.en: Mathēmatikos meant 'fond of learning, learned'; ta mathēmatika named the things studied rather than a single science.
items.cn: mathēmatikos 意为「爱学习的、有学问的」；中性复数形式指的是所学的那些东西，而非单一学科。

items.en: The phrase mathēmatikē tekhnē, 'the art of learning', was narrowed by Plato and Aristotle to arithmetic, geometry, astronomy and music.
items.cn: 「学习的技艺」这一短语经柏拉图与亚里士多德之手，收窄为算术、几何、天文与音乐四门。

items.en: Latin took mathematica as a name for that group of studies, and medieval schools taught them in the quadrivial curriculum.
items.cn: 拉丁语以 mathematica 作为这组学问之名，中世纪学校在四艺课程中教授它们。

items.en: English adopted the word in the sixteenth century; the plural form is treated as singular because it names one field.
items.cn: 英语在十六世纪吸收这个词；复数外形被当作单数使用，因为它命名的是一个领域。

items.en: From the nineteenth century the field expanded far beyond number and shape, and the old sense of any learning survives only in histories of the curriculum. First date uncertain: the earliest English citation is placed in the sixteenth century but no single year is agreed.
items.cn: 从十九世纪起，该领域远远超出数与形，而「任何学问」的旧义只留在课程史中。首见年代不确定：最早英语书证被放在十六世纪，但没有公认的确切年份。

note.en: Group one separates forms of the same word that are easy to mix up; group two separates the neighbouring branches of the field.
note.cn: 第一组辨析同一个词的各种形式，第二组辨析相邻的学科分支。

entries.definition: An older singular and adjective form, now rare; modern English keeps the plural shape for the field and uses mathematical for the adjective.
entries.definitionCN: 更早的单数形式与形容词形式，今已罕用；现代英语以复数外形指该领域，形容词则另用形式。

entries.definition: The adjective of the field; it describes work or reasoning rather than naming the discipline itself.
entries.definitionCN: 该领域的形容词；它描述工作或推理，而不命名学科本身。

entries.definition: The practitioner; the ending marks a person, which is the one clear difference from the field name.
entries.definitionCN: 指从业者；词尾标记出人，这是与学科名唯一清楚的差别。

entries.definition: A rare English borrowing of the Greek noun for learning, used in older philosophical writing; it never named the school subject.
entries.definitionCN: 英语直接从希腊语借入的罕见名词，意为学习，见于较早的哲学写作；它从未指学校科目。

entries.definition: The branch that handles counting and the four operations; it is a part of mathematics, not a synonym for it.
entries.definitionCN: 处理计数与四则运算的分支；它是数学的一部分，而不是数学的同义词。

entries.definition: The branch that works with symbols standing for unknown numbers; one department within the larger field.
entries.definitionCN: 用符号代表未知数进行运算的分支；是更大领域中的一个部门。

entries.definition: The branch that studies shape, size and the relations of figures in space.
entries.definitionCN: 研究形状、大小与空间中图形关系的分支。

entries.definition: The practical ability to handle numbers in daily life; it is a skill, whereas mathematics is a discipline.
entries.definitionCN: 在日常生活中处理数字的实际能力；它是一种技能，而数学是一门学问。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real fixed phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实固定搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The Greek root means 'that which is learned', so mathematics began as the name for any studied subject.
normal.cn: 希腊词根意为「被学到的东西」，因此数学最初泛指任何被研习的科目。

normal.en: The plural shape takes a singular verb: mathematics is one field, not many.
normal.cn: 复数外形接单数动词：数学是一个领域，而不是许多个。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the division of the field: pure mathematics, applied mathematics, advanced mathematics.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出领域的划分：纯数学、应用数学、高等数学。

normal.en: The family runs mathematics, mathematical, mathematician, mathematically, plus the clippings math and maths.
normal.cn: 同族词包括数学、数学的、数学家、在数学上，另有口语缩略形式。

normal.en: Ancient schooling grouped it with music and astronomy, so the old sense was wider than today's.
normal.cn: 古代课程把它与音乐、天文编在一起，因此旧义比今天宽。

abstract.en: Picture a single chalk line drawn again and again until it is unmistakably straight.
abstract.cn: 想象一条粉笔线被反复描画，直到直得无可置疑。

abstract.en: Picture a key ring that opens every locked door in a building, whatever the door was made for.
abstract.cn: 想象一串钥匙能打开楼里每一扇锁着的门，无论那扇门原本是做什么用的。

abstract.en: Picture a language spoken by few people but understood, in translation, by everyone.
abstract.cn: 想象一种只有少数人会说的语言，却人人能通过翻译读懂。

examples.en: Mathematics is compulsory for every student in the first two years.
examples.cn: 头两年每个学生都必须学数学。

examples.en: The mathematics of the model turned out to be simpler than expected.
examples.cn: 这个模型的数学部分比预想的简单。

examples.en: He teaches mathematics at a secondary school.
examples.cn: 他在一所中学教数学。

dict_mnemonic.text: 记作「学来的东西」：希腊词根意为学习，凡学得的学问都算 → 数学

root: 希腊 mathēma「被学到的东西」源自动词 manthanein「学习」，mathēmatikē tekhnē 经柏拉图与亚里士多德收窄为四艺；拉丁 mathematica 承之，英语十六世纪借入，复数外形作单数用。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses move from the discipline as a whole to its school hours, its practical working, the structure inside another subject, its professional community, plain-speech reckoning, the ancient sense of any learning, and the mathematics inside a single paper.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从作为整体的学科，移到它的课时、实际运算、另一对象内部的结构、专业共同体、口语里的算账、古代泛指学问的旧义，最后到一篇论文里的数学部分。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a blackboard filled with lines of symbols, one equal sign pressed hard at the end.
core.cn: 核心意象：写满符号行的黑板，末尾一个被重重描过的等号。

branches.en: The field and its old name: what began as any studied subject became one discipline.
branches.cn: 领域与其旧名：最初泛指任何被研习的科目，后来成了一口学科。

branches.en: Where it is taught and where it is printed: a timetable hour and a thin section of a paper.
branches.cn: 教它的地方与印它的地方：课表上的一节，论文里薄弱的一节。

branches.en: Reckoning in practice: the sums behind a bridge or behind a deal.
branches.cn: 实际算账：桥背后的算式，或一笔交易背后的账。

branches.en: The hidden structure: every regular system carries a mathematics of its own.
branches.cn: 隐在的结构：每个有规律的系统都自带一套数学。

branches.en: The people: a field is also the body of those who work in it.
branches.cn: 人：一个领域也是从事者的群体。

intro.en: The English word is a Greek noun with a Greek suffix, filtered through Latin and given an English plural ending.
intro.cn: 这个英语词是一个希腊名词加希腊后缀，经拉丁语过滤，又换上英语复数词尾。

latinIntro.en: Greek mathēma and mathēmatikos supply the meaning; Latin mathematica fixed the school subject, and English added the plural -s.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语的名词与形容词提供意义；拉丁语固定了学科之名，英语再加复数词尾。

items.example: The root names learning before it names number.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根先指学习，后指数。

items.example: The verb stands at the head of the whole family.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词位于整个词族的起点。

items.example: The suffix names a skilled practice, not a body of facts.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀命名一门技艺，而非一堆事实。

items.meaningCN: 有学问的；属于数学之物的
items.example: The adjective shifted from 'learned' to 'numerical'.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词从「有学问的」转为「数理的」。

items.example: Latin fixed the plural shape that English inherited.
items.exampleCN: 拉丁语固定了英语所继承的复数外形。

items.structure: English plural ending used for fields of study
items.example: The ending marks a discipline while keeping a plural look.
items.exampleCN: 这个词尾标记一门学科，同时保留复数外形。

items.example: The word names one field with a plural form.
items.exampleCN: 这个词以复数形式命名一个领域。

items.example: The adjective serves whenever a noun follows.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词用于修饰后面的名词。

items.meaning: a person who works in the field
items.example: The person suffix completes the family.
items.exampleCN: 表人后缀补全了词族。
